Name: Stardew - Space Age
Author: SwitchPosty
Description:
[b][color=#d4d4d8][size=5]Stardew: Space Age[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[i]Pelican Town was never going to be enough.[/i]

Build your own rocket, stock it with fuel and cargo, and launch yourself to Mars. Every expedition lands you on a fresh, procedurally generated Martian surface - new craters, new dust, new rocks to crack open and new things that want to crack [i]you[/i] open. Pack smart, watch your fuel, and bring the good stuff home.[/color]


[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[b]The Rocket[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Craft and place your own rocket on the farm - a big, custom-drawn machine you can be proud of.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Full rocket menu with [b]Systems[/b] and [b]Storage[/b] tabs: fuel bay, module bays, and an expandable cargo hold.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]6 cargo slots, 1 fuel slot, and 4 module slots on the base hull.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Route navigator built into the rocket: Mars is open for business, more destinations (Moon and beyond) are on the flight plan.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Fuel & Flight Rules[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Craft [b]Rocket Fuel Canisters[/b] from Oil, Coal, a Battery Pack, and Refined Quartz.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]A launch reserves a [b]round-trip charge[/b] — two canisters, so you always have fuel to come home. No strandings.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install an [b]Efficient Engine Module[/b] to cut a Mars round trip down to a single canister.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Mars Expeditions[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Procedurally generated terrain[/b]: craters, dunes, wind-carved plains and color zones, generated fresh from a seed every expedition. No two landing sites are the same.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Persistent vanilla-style resource nodes across the surface - grab your pickaxe and go to work.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Martian wildlife: armored larvae, leaping spider-things, and oddly peaceful rock crabs, each with their own drops and XP.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]A protective [b]force-field dome[/b] over the landing site that slowly restores your health and stamina. Step outside at your own risk.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Emergency recovery: if you go down on Mars, you're dragged back to the landing field instead of waking up in Harvey's clinic.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Loot & Progression[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Mine Martian rock for coal, geodes, ore and more - creature drops include rare finds like void essence and omni geodes.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Expand your rocket with [b]Cargo Bay Modules[/b] (+3 cargo slots each, up to four) and tune it with engine upgrades.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Whatever you load into the cargo hold travels back with the rocket. Haul it all home.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]
[b]In-game Field Manual[/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Press [b]F8[/b] any time to open the Space Guide - a book-style manual covering expeditions, Mars survival, and rocket mechanics.[/color][/*]
[/list]

[line]



[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size][/color]


   
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6+ [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size][/color]

[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI if you haven't already.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and unzip this mod.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Drop the [b]Stardew Space Age[/b] folder into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch through SMAPI. That's it.[/color][/*]
[/list]


[line]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[size=4][b]Feedback & Support[/b][/size]

Found a bug? Got an idea for a module, a monster, or a whole planet? Drop a comment - feedback and bug reports are very welcome.[/color]
